title: Engineering Manager – PHP & Web Tech
description:
We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to lead software engineering teams, optimize delivery processes, and drive people development across multiple product teams. The role primarily focuses on engineering team management, delivery excellence, Agile execution, and stakeholder collaboration rather than hands-on development.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage software engineers and cross-functional teams to ensure timely, high-quality delivery.
* Drive sprint planning, roadmap execution, delivery tracking, and risk management.
* Coach engineers and Technical Leads, manage performance, and support career development.
* Monitor engineering KPIs, including DORA and SPACE metrics, to improve productivity and delivery predictability.
* Establish effective Agile practices, CI/CD workflows, release governance, and quality standards.
* Collaborate with Product, QA, DevOps, and senior leadership to resolve dependencies and delivery blockers.
* Promote team engagement, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Proven engineering management experience, including managing teams of 5+ engineers.
* Strong people leadership, mentoring, performance management, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Experience with Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban.
* Knowledge of DORA metrics, engineering delivery KPIs, CI/CD, and software release processes.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams, delivery commitments, and stakeholder expectations.
* Strong communication and distributed-team management skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Previous experience in software development or technical leadership.
* Familiarity with PHP, Node.js, TypeScript, AWS, or API gateways.
* Experience with SaaS products, API-driven applications, and cloud-native platforms.
* Knowledge of SRE, platform reliability, and engineering process transformation.

title: Backend Developer
description:
We are looking for a Backend Developer with 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in Node.js and Python to join our engineering team. You will build and maintain server\-side applications, RESTful APIs, database systems, and business logic. You will work closely with frontend developers, product managers, and DevOps teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable applications.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, develop, and maintain RESTful or GraphQL APIs using Node.js and Python.
* Build server\-side logic and application workflows.
* Develop backend services using Node.js frameworks and Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask.
* Design clean database schemas and write optimized queries.
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Develop secure authentication and authorization systems using JWT, OAuth, or similar methods.
* Connect third\-party services such as payment gateways, cloud storage, and messaging platforms.
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks.
* Implement caching solutions such as Redis when required.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code.
* Conduct and participate in code reviews.
* Troubleshoot bugs and production issues.
* Work with frontend developers, product managers, and DevOps teams.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum meetings, requirement discussions, and effort estimation.



  





**Required Skills** 



* 2\+ years of professional experience in backend development with Node.js and/or Python.
* Strong knowledge of modern JavaScript and ES6\+.
* Good knowledge of Python programming and backend development.
* Good understanding of asynchronous programming, Promises, Async/Await, and the Node.js Event Loop.
* Hands\-on experience with Express.js, NestJS, FastAPI, Django, Flask, or similar frameworks.
* Strong understanding of RESTful API development.
* Experience with middleware, error handling, authentication, and API security.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar databases.
* Knowledge of database schema design and query optimization.
* Experience with ORM/ODM tools such as Prisma, TypeORM, Mongoose, Sequelize, SQLAlchemy, or Django ORM.
* Knowledge of Git and version control workflows.
* Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman or Insomnia.
* Basic understanding of Docker and Linux.
* Familiarity with CI/CD and deployment processes.
* TypeScript experience is preferred.



  





**Tools and Technologies** 



* Node.js
* Python
* Express.js / NestJS
* FastAPI / Django / Flask
* JavaScript / TypeScript
* PostgreSQL / MySQL / MongoDB
* Prisma / TypeORM / Mongoose / Sequelize
* SQLAlchemy / Django ORM
* REST API / GraphQL
* Redis
* JWT / OAuth
* Git / GitHub
* Postman / Insomnia
* Docker
* Linux
* Jest / Mocha / Pytest
* CI/CD pipelines



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of professional backend development experience.
* Experience working on production\-grade Node.js and/or Python applications.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Good understanding of software development practices.
* Ability to work independently as well as with a development team.



  





**What We Expect** 



* Write clean, structured, and maintainable code.
* Take ownership of assigned backend features and tasks.
* Understand requirements and convert them into practical technical solutions.
* Follow coding standards and development best practices.
* Test your work before delivery.
* Communicate clearly with team members and stakeholders.
* Be willing to learn new technologies and improve your technical skills.
* Take responsibility for resolving issues and delivering tasks within agreed timelines.



  





**Location Requirement** 



* Kerala\-based candidates only
